caption_L1: Salt sales revenues in the United States from 1989 to 2009 (in U.S. dollars) is a area graph. Year is drawn as a linear scale with a minimum of 1990 and a maximum of 2005 on the x-axis. The y-axis plots Sales revenues in U.S. dollars using a linear scale from 0 to 2,000,000,000.
caption_L2L3: The graph itself is displaying the revenue of salt sales in the United States in US dollars between 1989-2009. The graph shows a steady rise in the revenues, however a significant increase between 2000-2005 before declining steadily again. Shortly after 2005, the revenues rise drastically and do not appear to decline again at any point.
